records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Net sales decreased $41,900,000 or 15% to $240,997,000 for the three months ended December 26, 2020.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Price increases had marginal impact on results in the quarter as traffic and volume drove almost all the sales decline compared to last year.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Sales to food service customers decreased $23,023,000 or 13% in the first quarter to $160,425,000.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Operating income in our Food Service segment decreased $11,854,000 in the quarter to $6,180,000 primarily because of sales declines which impacted margin efficiencies and expense leverage.

records.title: FORM 10-Q
records.text: Operating income decreased $21,125,000 or 97% for the quarter to $578,000.
